observations.description: 黄色塑料购物篮放在白色桌面上，篮上有黑色提手，篮内初始为空；画面右上方的黑色机械臂夹着一个红色易拉罐停在篮右侧桌面，画面左侧的另一机械臂从左进入并移动到篮的左上方/篮口附近。

observations.description: A yellow basket with a black handle sits on a white table. Initially, the basket is empty; a black robotic gripper on the right holds a red cylindrical can on the table to the basket’s right, while another black robotic gripper enters from the left and moves toward the basket’s left edge/handle area.

The left gripper places a red-and-silver wrapped object into the basket, then the right gripper moves the red can from the table toward the basket and lowers it into the basket; the gripper presses or adjusts the can inside the basket while the can remains within the basket.

The gripper moves away from the basket; the red can is visible standing inside the basket, then the can disappears from view inside the basket, and the gripper is seen holding a red-and-white can at the left side of the table.
The gripper moves the red can from the left back over the basket and lowers it into the basket, with the can positioned inside the basket under the gripper at the final shown frame.

uncertainties: Between frames 105 and 108, the red can that was visible inside the basket disappears from view; the cause (removal, falling, or occlusion) is not clearly shown in the provided frames.
Motion blur during fast gripper movements limits fine detail of the can’s orientation and exact contact points in some frames.
